page.layout: One printed page, left part of a two-part scan. Running head across the top. Left column: a list of Roman numerals with topic brackets "De" (XXIV–XXVII), then a heading "LOCUS XXVI." and a large heading "DE ECCLESIA.", then a numbered list I–XV with bracketed "De" groups. Cut off at the right edge.; One column of short lines at the right side of the page: a column of verse references (numbers) in the centre-right, with fragments of words at the left edge ("Thef.", "riè", "ùs", "a-", "ifi-", "o-", "el-") that belong to the left-hand column cut off; at the foot a heading "LOCUS" in spaced capitals.

main_text.l: III. | Ecclesia vera augustè & propriè dicta.
IV. | Ecclesia vera impropriè & latiùs dicta.

page.notes: The right part of the page is cut off; lines are cut at the right edge and are transcribed only as far as visible. Ornament at the foot (a row of small X-shaped fleurons) is not text. Right-edge fragments of the second part are not transcribed. Left-hand column of the opening is cut off; only fragments of its words survive at the left edge. The fragments "riè", "ùs", "a-", "ifi-", "o-", "el-" are hyphenated line ends from that column. The heading LOCUS is set in spaced italic capitals and is left as a level 1 heading.
